title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30389: allow skipping service item confirmation
summary: The ServItemManagement codeunit now allows extensions to skip the service item confirmation dialog through a new event parameter while preserving the standard creation logic.
key_points: SkipConfirm parameter appended to the existing pre-confirmation event in CreateServItemOnServItemLine
Subscribers can skip only the confirmation dialog and still go through standard service item creation
The existing full-bypass behavior is kept
quote: Extensions need to create service items with the standard application logic without displaying the interactive confirmation dialog
